name: Nordic stave church
summary: A tidy stone base and ground-floor gallery carry the right stave-church idea, but the tiered roofs read as a mottled pagoda pyramid, with random blackstone patches instead of shingles and no real dragon gables, so the silhouette is more Japanese temple than Norwegian stave church.

log.summary: The tiered silhouette, stone base, and spire read as a stave church from a distance, but the roofs are blocky grey stair-stepped slabs, the gable ends are muddy two-tone planks, and the thin ground floor looks like a bare open pavilion rather than a tarred timber gallery.
